tidymapr: Tidy Mapping, Spatial Analysis and Publication Cartography

tidymapr-package.Rd

Publication-quality maps and spatial analysis in R, in the style of a desktop GIS: automatic, explained map design (geo_automap()), projections, legends and map furniture, GIS, CAD and remote sensing formats, and fast C++ spatial statistics. Compatible with the GeoSpaX (https://geospax.in4metrix.dev) desktop GIS, whose cartographic conventions it follows. For ecology it works with tidydiversity in the same way dplyr and ggplot2 do: every verb takes a data frame and returns a tibble, an sf table, a SpatRaster or a ggplot.
